answer: AI agent economies resist Sybil attacks via costly identity-bound staking. Each agent must lock substantial, unique tokens. An attacker attempting to flood the network needs to acquire an astronomical amount of these scarce tokens, making a "comet" of new identities economically unfeasible. Furthermore, a verifiable identity must be attested, preventing a mere "whisper" from creating a new persona. The immutable ledger, like solid "marble", ensures that forging additional identities incurs a high, unrecoverable economic cost per forged identity, ensuring scarce resource allocation.
